# Public browser port provenance

`laya-core.js`, `LICENSE`, `NOTICE.md`, and `licenses/` were copied byte-for-byte from [`vishalmysore/layaForWeb`](https://github.com/vishalmysore/layaForWeb) commit `6e67de8d8ccaf9474c9150c3f3877878d915020b` (Apache-2.0). The adjacent `laya-core.js` SHA-256 is `9ad9090aff685eebc4b7fd6d3fff353aa42a7a4b8c6f9147928134a6a0459090`.

ReelDeal's loader and typed result adapter are new glue code. The model itself is the public `VishalMysore/layaForWebTrained` conversion of `convaiinnovations/laya-typed-decisions`, pinned in `../../src/laya-lock.ts`. No weights are copied into this repository. The Pages build copies locally installed ONNX Runtime Web WASM files and license notices, not a hosted inference client.

This checkpoint was fine-tuned on non-fish workflows. Its output is an advisory typed answer for this demonstration, not a validated fish species or quality classifier.
